_comment: Country groupings. Groups must not overlap: each country belongs to at most one group. Members come from an explicit ISO3 list, or from UN M49 region codes (m49_region / m49_subregion / m49_intermediate), minus `exclude`. Membership uses current composition for all years.

groups.name: European Union (EU-27)
groups.note: Current 27 member states (post-Brexit) applied to all years.

groups.name: ASEAN
groups.note: Ten founding/expansion members plus Timor-Leste (admitted October 2025), applied to all years.

groups.name: Africa
groups.note: All countries in the UN M49 region Africa.

groups.name: South America
groups.note: UN M49 intermediate region South America.

groups.name: Central America & Caribbean
groups.note: UN M49 Central America and Caribbean, excluding Mexico.
